Container.Name: mcpopus
Container.Overview: MCP Octopus: one self-hosted MCP host serving several MCP endpoints (one per plugin) with built-in OAuth, for use as custom connectors in Claude. Plugins are installed from git repositories in the admin UI, no rebuild needed. Put a reverse proxy in front of port 8080; keep the admin port 8081 on your LAN. Docs at https://github.com/Poag/mcpopus.

Config.Name: Public listener
Config.Description: MCP and OAuth endpoints. Put your reverse proxy / tunnel in front of this; do not expose it directly.

Config.Name: Admin listener
Config.Description: Admin UI. LAN only: never route it through a proxy or tunnel.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, audit log, plugin data and installed plugins.

Config.Name: MCPOPUS_PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: Public https name Claude reaches the host by (no path, no trailing slash).

Config.Name: MCPOPUS_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Encrypts stored secrets. Make one with: docker run --rm ghcr.io/poag/mcpopus:latest genkey. Keep a copy; losing it loses stored plugin secrets.

Config.Name: MCPOPUS_OAUTH_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Connector sign-in password, different from the admin one.

Config.Name: MCPOPUS_ADMIN_ALLOWED_HOSTS
Config.Description: Hostnames you browse the admin UI by, comma separated (IP addresses always work).

Config.Name: MCPOPUS_TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS
Config.Description: true only if port 8080 is reachable solely through your reverse proxy.
